stem: A retail collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI prescription for the patient's referred diagnosis. Which actions are required? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Add Schedule II refills under the same agreement.
Keep the prescription within the diagnosis and agreement scope.
Send a copy to the supervising physician within 24 hours.
Delay physician notice until the agreement is renewed.
Document the prescription in the patient's collaborative-practice record.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supported conclusions on these facts are: Keep the prescription within the diagnosis and agreement scope. Send a copy to the supervising physician within 24 hours. Document the prescription in the patient's collaborative-practice record.

choice_analysis.A: Not supported: Add Schedule II refills under the same agreement.
choice_analysis.B: Supported: Keep the prescription within the diagnosis and agreement scope.
choice_analysis.C: Supported: Send a copy to the supervising physician within 24 hours.
choice_analysis.D: Not supported: Delay physician notice until the agreement is renewed.
choice_analysis.E: Supported: Document the prescription in the patient's collaborative-practice record.

related_facts: A properly authorized retail collaborating pharmacist may issue Schedule VI prescriptions for the referred diagnosis and must send a copy to the supervising physician within 24 hours.
explanation.mpje_trap: Distinguish this near-miss from the controlling rule: 'Add Schedule II refills under the same agreement.'
